ListSql:
SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[ID]), [c].[Name], [c].[DisplayName], [c].[ShortCode], [c].[IntegrationId], [c].[TerminationDate], CASE
    WHEN [c].[CityID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[CityID])
END, CASE
    WHEN [c].[RegionID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[RegionID])
END, CASE
    WHEN [c].[CompanyID] IS NOT NULL THEN CONVERT(varchar(20), [c].[CompanyID])
END, COALESCE([c].[PublishTargets], CAST(N'[]' AS nvarchar(max))), [c].[DisplayOrder], [c].[IsDeleted], [c0].[Name], [r].[Name], [c1].[Name], [c0].[TerminationDate], CASE
    WHEN [c1].[ID] IS NOT NULL AND [r0].[ID] IS NOT NULL AND [c2].[ID] IS NOT NULL THEN [c2].[DisplayOrder]
END, CASE
    WHEN [c1].[ID] IS NOT NULL AND [r0].[ID] IS NOT NULL THEN [r0].[DisplayOrder]
END, [c1].[DisplayOrder], [c0].[DisplayOrder], [c].[ID], [c0].[ID], [r].[ID], [c1].[ID], [r0].[ID], [c2].[ID], [s0].[Value], [s0].[Text], [s0].[ID], [s0].[ID0], [s1].[Value], [s1].[Text], [s1].[ID], [s1].[ID0], [s2].[Value], [s2].[Text], [s2].[ID], [s2].[ID0]
FROM [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranches] AS [c]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Companies] AS [c0] ON [c].[CompanyID] = [c0].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Regions] AS [r] ON [c].[RegionID] = [r].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Cities] AS [c1] ON [c].[CityID] = [c1].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Regions] AS [r0] ON [c1].[RegionID] = [r0].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Countries] AS [c2] ON [r0].[CountryID] = [c2].[ID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c3].[BrandID]) AS [Value], [b].[Name] AS [Text], [c3].[ID], [b].[ID] AS [ID0], [c3].[CompanyBranchID]
    FROM [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranchBrands] AS [c3]
    INNER JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Brands] AS [b] ON [c3].[BrandID] = [b].[ID]
) AS [s0] ON [c].[ID] = [s0].[CompanyBranchID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c4].[DepartmentID]) AS [Value], [d].[Name] AS [Text], [c4].[ID], [d].[ID] AS [ID0], [c4].[CompanyBranchID]
    FROM [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranchDepartments] AS [c4]
    INNER JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Departments] AS [d] ON [c4].[DepartmentID] = [d].[ID]
) AS [s1] ON [c].[ID] = [s1].[CompanyBranchID]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CONVERT(varchar(20), [c5].[ServiceID]) AS [Value], [s].[Name] AS [Text], [c5].[ID], [s].[ID] AS [ID0], [c5].[CompanyBranchID]
    FROM [ShiftIdentity].[CompanyBranchServices] AS [c5]
    INNER JOIN [ShiftIdentity].[Services] AS [s] ON [c5].[ServiceID] = [s].[ID]
) AS [s2] ON [c].[ID] = [s2].[CompanyBranchID]
ORDER BY [c].[ID], [c0].[ID], [r].[ID], [c1].[ID], [r0].[ID], [c2].[ID], [s0].[ID], [s0].[ID0], [s1].[ID], [s1].[ID0], [s2].[ID]
